children: China kept its benchmark lending rates unchanged for the 16th straight month on Sunday, in line with market expectations.
The one-year loan prime rate (CNYLPR1Y=CFXS) was kept at 3.00%, while the five-year LPR (CNYLPR5Y=CFXS) was unchanged at 3.50%.
All 21 market participants in a Reuters survey forecast no change to either rate.
Most new and outstanding loans in China are based on the one-year LPR, while the five-year rate influences the pricing of mortgages.
